content.comment_body: Is it possible to use [product_name] to regularly ping an IP address and receive an SMS notification (using the [product_name] GSM module [article_no]) if the ping fails? I'm not sure if this is feasible or how to set it up. Can anyone assist? Thanks.

No, this cannot be done automatically through programming. The ping function is only accessible manually through the [product_name] menu ([article_no] or newer): Main menu > Diagnostics > Tools > Ping. Could you clarify the reason for needing a ping test—perhaps to act as a 'Watch Dog'? If so, consider creating a custom Watch Dog between the [product_name] and the other device.
Hello, as suggested, setting up your own watchdog that updates periodically would be as effective as continuously pinging the device.

analysis.insight_summary: Community members highlight that [product_name] lacks the ability to automatically ping an IP address and send SMS alerts using the GSM module in its standard configuration. Only a manual ping option is available via the device menu, limiting automated network monitoring and alerts. Users express a need for a programmable solution for network monitoring and automatic notifications.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to support automated network ping functionality and be able to trigger SMS alerts through the GSM module whenever network connectivity issues arise.
